D1.explanation: Administered dose exceeds the maximum recommended adult single dose from drug specifications.
D1.title: Dose Exceeds Maximum Safe Single Dose

D2.explanation: Patients with renal impairment (CrCl < 60 mL/min) receiving renally cleared drugs (fe > 0.4) require dose reduction.
D2.title: Unadjusted Dose in Renal Impairment

D3.explanation: Selected administration route is incompatible with drug bioavailability (e.g. oral route for aminoglycosides or glycopeptides).
D3.title: Route Mismatch (Incompatible Bioavailability)

D4.explanation: Patient parameters must remain within adult boundary limits (Age 18-90, Weight 40-150 kg, CrCl 15-150 mL/min).
D4.title: Out-of-Bounds Adult Covariates Requested

D5.explanation: Narrow therapeutic index drugs require at least 3 blood sampling observation timepoints to characterize PK curve.
D5.title: Inadequate Sampling Count for Narrow Therapeutic Index Drug

D6.explanation: Intravenous infusions must not be administered in under 15 minutes (< 0.25h) to avoid adverse infusion reactions.
D6.title: Excessive Infusion Rate / Duration Too Short

D7.explanation: Enter your predicted peak concentration and target window duration before executing simulation.
D7.title: Missing Target Window Prediction

D8.explanation: Simulated Cmax exceeds the toxic concentration threshold (toxicity risk). Regimen adjustment required.
D8.title: Toxic Peak Concentration Exceeded

R10_CLEAN_FINISH.explanation: Always doff PPE and perform thorough hygienic handwashing at the sink before handling documentation and submitting official laboratory records.
R10_CLEAN_FINISH.title: Aseptic Handwash / PPE Removal Incomplete

R1_GOGGLES.explanation: Safety goggles must be worn whenever handling chemicals, drugs, or blood to prevent permanent corneal caustic burns or ocular pathogen transmission.
R1_GOGGLES.title: Eye Protection Missing

R2_GLOVES.explanation: Protective gloves must be worn when manipulating acids, bases, or patient blood to prevent chemical contact burns and biohazard contamination.
R2_GLOVES.title: Protective Gloves Missing

R3_LAB_COAT.explanation: A standard buttoned lab coat shields everyday clothing and exposed skin from accidental chemical droplets, drug powders, and aerosol contamination.
R3_LAB_COAT.title: Protective Lab Coat Missing

R4_TARE_FIRST.explanation: Digital analytical balances must always be zeroed (tared) with the tare dish prior to weighing active medicinal ingredients to avoid systematic dose errors.
R4_TARE_FIRST.title: Balance Not Tared

R5_LABEL_SAMPLES.explanation: Venous collection tubes and medication cups must be explicitly labelled before use to prevent catastrophic specimen misidentification or wrong-patient administration.
R5_LABEL_SAMPLES.title: Unlabelled Specimen or Medication

R6_ACID_INTO_WATER.explanation: Always add acid slowly to water ('AAA'). Adding water directly to concentrated acid generates sudden localized boiling and violent corrosive acid splattering.
R6_ACID_INTO_WATER.title: Hazardous Acid Dilution Sequence

R7_BURETTE_OVERFILL.explanation: Burettes must be conditioned with titrant rinse to prevent water dilution error, and must never be filled above the calibrated 50 mL meniscus limit.
R7_BURETTE_OVERFILL.title: Burette Conditioning or Capacity Breach

R8_DOSE_LIMIT.explanation: Administering paracetamol above the maximum adult single dose limit (1000 mg) depletes endogenous glutathione and induces acute hepatic parenchymal necrosis.
R8_DOSE_LIMIT.title: Exceeded Maximum Safe Single Dose

R9_WASTE_BINS.explanation: Biological sharps and blood tubes must be deposited strictly in biohazard containers; chemical reagents must enter chemical waste to prevent dangerous autoclave explosions.
R9_WASTE_BINS.title: Hazardous Waste Incompatible Segregation

S1_PREFLIGHT_CHECKLIST.explanation: Flight computer preflight systems diagnostic checklist must be executed and confirmed before initiating terminal launch countdown and engine ignition sequence.
S1_PREFLIGHT_CHECKLIST.title: Launch Attempted Without Preflight Checklist

S2_PROPELLANT_CAPACITY.explanation: Rocket stage propellant tanks must be loaded with positive mass within rated structural tank capacity limits to prevent catastrophic tank rupture or dry engine ignition.
S2_PROPELLANT_CAPACITY.title: Propellant Tank Capacity Exceeded or Empty

S3_TWR_LIFTOFF.explanation: Liftoff thrust must strictly exceed vehicle liftoff weight (TWR > 1.0). An under-powered rocket cannot lift off, pinning the vehicle to the pad while exhaust destroys pad infrastructure.
S3_TWR_LIFTOFF.title: Insufficient Thrust-to-Weight Ratio (TWR <= 1.0)

S4_PAYLOAD_DECLARED.explanation: Orbital payload mass must be declared and must not exceed the vehicle's structural payload capacity to preserve mission aerodynamic and mass budget stability.
S4_PAYLOAD_DECLARED.title: Undeclared or Excessive Payload Mass

S5_STAGING_ORDER.explanation: Lower booster stages must complete their burn before upper stage ignition and interstage separation. Igniting upper stages prematurely causes plume impingement and vehicle breakup.
S5_STAGING_ORDER.title: Premature Upper Stage Ignition / Staging Order Breach

S6_RANGE_SAFETY.explanation: Launch operations require affirmative range clearance from tracking radar and downrange safety officers to protect airspace, shipping corridors, and populated zones.
S6_RANGE_SAFETY.title: Launch Attempted Without Range Clearance

S7_DV_MARGIN.explanation: Sound mission planning requires at least a 5% delta-v reserve margin above nominal orbital insertion requirements to absorb atmospheric drag and steering losses.
S7_DV_MARGIN.title: Insufficient Delta-V Margin (<5%)

S8_DEBRIEF_CLEANUP.explanation: Flight telemetry, achieved orbital parameters, and propellant margins must be debriefed with tracking station before submitting final mission analytical documentation.
S8_DEBRIEF_CLEANUP.title: Report Submitted Without Mission Debrief
